It tells the story of Ryoma, a high school student who rises as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the coming end of the world. Along the way, Ryoma discovers candidates to become “Prisma Knights,” who share the same destiny of saving the world. By awakening them with his kiss, he sets out on an adventure together with his companions. ◆ STORY ◆ Just kiss—— Kiss is the only way to save two worlds destined for ruin. Set in Amazia, a land fused with another world and fated for destruction, this is the story of Ryouma, who becomes the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” and throws himself into a battle to save two worlds from the brink of annihilation. Find the companions who have also been drawn into Amazia from the real world, and awaken their power as Prisma Knights through a kiss. The only way to save the world is a kiss—— ◆ WORLD ◆ The story takes place in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and is burdened with a doomed fate. This beautiful yet decadent world is brought to life through the artwork by tokyogenso. Witness for yourself the transformed city such as Shibuya and Akihabara, now merged with another world. ◆ DUNGEON ◆ Across the districts of Tokyo fused with another world, labyrinths unlike anything in the real world await. Inside the dungeons, various exploration elements await you, including battles against monsters, gimmicks blocking your path, treasure chests to discover, and materials and items to gather. Collect equipment and items, strengthen your party, and aim for the deepest reaches of each labyrinth. ◆ BATTLE ◆ The only way to save the world is a kiss——! Fight against the world’s destruction together with the Prisma Knights. Battles in this title use a turn-based command battle system. Form a party of up to four characters, choose their front-row and back-row positions, and select the skills they use in battle. Build your strategy around enemy traits and the flow of battle, and enjoy highly tactical combat. The auto-battle function also allows you to progress through battles at a faster pace. ・EXS（Special Attacks） As the savior “Prisma,” the protagonist is the only one capable of absorbing “EXS,” the source of power in this world, by defeating enemies. The EXS he absorbs can be shared with his allies, the Prisma Knights, through a kiss, awakening their power. Release EXS through a kiss with your companions and unleash powerful special attacks known as “EXS Arts.” ・Party Formation and Affection Up to four members can participate in battle. Your formation, including companions waiting in reserve, plays an important role depending on the situation. Your relationships with companions can also affect battle, so deepen your bonds not only with your favorite Prisma Knights, but with a variety of allies. ・Enchanting By combining skills found on weapons, armor, and accessories, you can greatly expand your battle options, including attacks and support effects. Gather materials, refine your skill setup, and challenge powerful enemies with your own strategy. *This product was developed based on 《EXSTETRA》, originally released in 2013. Some specifications differ from the original version.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A fantasy RPG where a kiss saves the world.

EXSTETRA is set in “Amazea,” a Tokyo fused with another world and fated for destruction.

It tells the story of Ryoma, a high school student who rises as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the coming end of the world.

Along the way, Ryoma discovers candidates to become “Prisma Knights,” who share the same destiny of saving the world. By awakening them with his kiss, he sets out on an adventure together with his companions.

◆ STORY ◆

Just kiss——

Kiss is the only way to save two worlds destined for ruin.

Set in Amazia, a land fused with another world and fated for destruction, this is the story of Ryouma, who becomes the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” and throws himself into a battle to save two worlds from the brink of annihilation.

Find the companions who have also been drawn into Amazia from the real world, and awaken their power as Prisma Knights through a kiss.

The only way to save the world is a kiss——

◆ WORLD ◆

The story takes place in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and is burdened with a doomed fate.

This beautiful yet decadent world is brought to life through the artwork by tokyogenso.

Witness for yourself the transformed city such as Shibuya and Akihabara, now merged with another world.

◆ DUNGEON ◆

Across the districts of Tokyo fused with another world, labyrinths unlike anything in the real world await.

Inside the dungeons, various exploration elements await you, including battles against monsters, gimmicks blocking your path, treasure chests to discover, and materials and items to gather.

Collect equipment and items, strengthen your party, and aim for the deepest reaches of each labyrinth.

◆ BATTLE ◆

The only way to save the world is a kiss——!
Fight against the world’s destruction together with the Prisma Knights.

Battles in this title use a turn-based command battle system.
Form a party of up to four characters, choose their front-row and back-row positions, and select the skills they use in battle.
Build your strategy around enemy traits and the flow of battle, and enjoy highly tactical combat.

The auto-battle function also allows you to progress through battles at a faster pace.

・EXS（Special Attacks）

As the savior “Prisma,” the protagonist is the only one capable of absorbing “EXS,” the source of power in this world, by defeating enemies.

The EXS he absorbs can be shared with his allies, the Prisma Knights, through a kiss, awakening their power.

Release EXS through a kiss with your companions and unleash powerful special attacks known as “EXS Arts.”

・Party Formation and Affection

Up to four members can participate in battle.
Your formation, including companions waiting in reserve, plays an important role depending on the situation.

Your relationships with companions can also affect battle, so deepen your bonds not only with your favorite Prisma Knights, but with a variety of allies.

・Enchanting

By combining skills found on weapons, armor, and accessories, you can greatly expand your battle options, including attacks and support effects.

Gather materials, refine your skill setup, and challenge powerful enemies with your own strategy.

*This product was developed based on 《EXSTETRA》, originally released in 2013. Some specifications differ from the original version.
